note: x, y: cell centre in metres of crs_source; lon, lat: WGS84 (present when pyproj is installed). row, col index the source raster grid. gedi: measured canopy heights (rh98, m).

fields.p_forest_gt5: model 1 score 0..1 (ranking, not a calibrated probability)
fields.recovery: state in the summer of now_year: share of the neighbouring-forest height regained (0..1, can slightly exceed 1)
fields.height_m: recovery * reference_height_m: modelled canopy height, not measured
fields.ndvi: Sentinel-2 NDVI, mean over the cell

reference_source: scene_p75_unburned_forest (no GEDI reference for this fire: not a validated reference)
